name: Merry
source:
The lord of the western-style «Kujo Manor». She is a beautiful, western-style doll who speaks human language. She protects those who were cursed by a strange phenomenon happening in the city.

[Edited from [url=http://gematsu.com/2017/01/death-mark-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu - Japanese Video Game News[/url]]
